name: Melatonin
description: Hormone the body makes mainly at night; most products are synthetic

note.text: The only randomized hair trial was a 40-woman pilot; the other scalp studies had no placebo group.

bullets: **Made by the body** mainly at night; helps run the sleep-wake cycle
**Hair follicle effects** reported in animal and cell studies
**Scalp use** raised blood melatonin, but below the normal night peak
**For hair loss in people,** the mechanism is not established
Small effects on time to fall asleep
Hair: one pilot RCT in 40 women

practical.routes: By mouth (sleep); on the scalp (hair studies)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Liver metabolism, mainly CYP1A (Circadin, EU label)
practical.soldAs: Dietary supplement (US); prescription in the EU and UK
practical.monitored: Time to fall asleep, sleep quality; growing-hair share

regulatory.text: Not approved; sold as a dietary supplement

references: NIH NCCIH, Melatonin: what you need to know, May 2024
Fischer et al., Br J Dermatol, melatonin scalp solution in women, Feb 2004
